Our online forms open at 7 each day in which you can detail your request or problem.  Only if you miss the form completion time will you have to do this the next day.   These requests are triaged by a GP the same day and allocated either an appointment, telephone call or reply.  Nurse appointments are bookable without the form and as you would expect are not a same day service.  Urgent issues will be passed to the duty doctor and / or advised if alternative is needed such as ambulance.  There is really no system in operation that allows booking an appointment to take 3 - 5 working days unless there is an issue with the dates you can attend in, which may mean some messages back and forth trying to get a suitable date, again a phone call to the Practice would alleviate this.  If there is an issue I encourage you to make use of our complaints procedure so we can investigate what and how it has happened. Unfortunately a lot of the community pharmacies are then sending patients back to the GP Practice, this is out of our control but understand this is frustrating for patients.  We are collecting cases such as yours to report this back as a problem.  Our online service switches off at 11 am due to capacity.  If you however feel that your issue is urgent you can call us and we will put the query through to the duty doctor.  It would appear however that if your family member gave you medicine (which must have been routine medicines available over the counter from any pharmacy, as pharmacists cannot prescribe medication for patients) and this has worked then the pharmacy service was the right service for you.  I have every confidence that our team members are not rude to patients, however all telephone calls are recorded so if you feel that any member of the team have been rude during a telephone call please follow our complaints procedure and we can investigate this properly. I’m sorry that you met with this apparent barrier and felt unable to arrange medical care for your son. Having our website forms to access the practice team is meant to reduce barriers.

You are most welcome to message in on behalf of your son through our website form before 1pm any day when we are open (and the earlier the better). This is the way we encourage everyone to bring something to us, either themselves or on behalf of someone they care for. We then arrange an appointment or ring/message back. There is an option on the form to click to say you’re doing this for someone else and of course we don’t give out any confidential information without appropriate permission and checks.
